problem: The static portable Linux executable does not load GNU NSS modules, so an existing directory account can be reported as absent by host-access. Lookup failures were also collapsed into absence.
implementation: Use a GNU headless engine for native DEB, RPM and AppImage; retain the static init, portable archive and Windows/WSL inputs.
Propagate account and group lookup failures instead of creating a group during a directory outage.
Bound the native engine ELF imports to glibc 2.34 and standard GNU runtime libraries, and declare package dependencies.
Run an actual NSS module in a disposable compiler container, restore its NSS configuration and preserve account-file hashes.
Measure native and portable engine builds separately against pinned Docker and Podman on the same Platform runner.
Represent missing groups separately from lookup errors; GNU ENOENT or ESRCH from an NSS backend is an error, while the existing non-GNU fallback stays unchanged.
Qualify ARM native GNU/NSS, AppImage and package lifecycle checks in Platform builds before merge, as well as the x86_64 checks.

released_negative_control.scope: One owned unprivileged GNU container on native Asagiri reproduced rejection of a genuine NSS account by the published static executable. The helper and its image were removed, and the original engine inventory was preserved.

access_compile_only.scope: ARM64 and x86_64 metadata-only compilation of the actual access module and NSS test bodies using musl targets and diagnostic adapters. This is not GNU linking or NSS runtime qualification.

actual_gnu_runtime.scope: Actual GNU engine and Cargo test executable plus same-source static control in one owned network-none container, with only SETUID/SETGID and no-new-privileges. The container and image were removed; native images, volumes, volume metadata and installed app binary were preserved.

gnu_compilation.limit: The local Zig adapter omits an unsupported Cortex-A53 linker erratum option for this Apple ARM VM probe. No hosted compiler flags change, and this build does not qualify Cortex-A53 hardware.

portable_control_compilation.limit: The local C adapter disables Zig implicit UBSan instrumentation because the direct Rust musl linker lacks that runtime. No sanitizer failure was suppressed and no hosted flags change.

independent_elf_inspection.scope: Actual local GNU engine and unit binary plus a published static control; rejects swapped roles, foreign architecture, a newer GLIBC version and a foreign runtime library.

missing_backend_regression.scope: Actual libc getgrnam_r distinguishes zero/null absence from ENOENT when the provider backend file is missing. The old GNU executable incorrectly reached the guarded group creation path for both. No account files changed; owned container and image were removed and original inventory preserved.

nss_coverage: Actual Unix peer credentials and socket ACL admission
Live revocation, closed connection and ACL removal
Full CLI resolution with blocked account-changing commands
Missing provider backend must remain an error for account/group lookup and admission, while established connections remain open
required_hosted_evidence.native_packages_and_appimage: pending on both Linux architectures before merge

limits: No real SSSD or Himmelblau deployment has been qualified.
The CLI checks stop at guarded account-changing commands; they do not qualify a real directory service administration workflow.
Cold pulls, full application workloads and directory-service latency are outside the five reference workloads.
The runtime fixture and these contracts are tests, not a formal verification claim.
No GNU native package has yet been published from this change.
